courses.summary: 火星是 Shell 深水生產中心之一；課程聚焦長期使用的浮式結構、循環歷史與液體處理。本課依序分析長年波浪循環帳、結構與管線減薄、成熟來液分離、停機與備件歷史、不同年代資料校正，每項都包含可重算模型、證據規劃、故障辨析與驗收成果。數字全部是教學假設；不宣稱本案例採用這些設備參數。
courses.summaryEn: Mars is one of Shell’s deepwater hubs; the case focuses on long-service floating structures, cycle history and liquid processing. The course analyses long-term wave-cycle account, structural and piping thinning, separation of mature-field liquids, downtime and spare-part history, calibration across data generations, with recalculable models, evidence plans, fault discrimination and acceptance artifacts. All numbers are teaching assumptions; no plant-specific parameter is asserted.
